mapper.update: update declared_yield_field_commodity_berries set total_production = #{dto.totalProduction, javaType=java.lang.Double , jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, total_production_override = #{dto.totalProductionOverride, javaType=java.lang.Double , jdbcType=NUMERIC, mode=IN}, update_user = #{userId, javaType=java.lang.String, jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}, update_date = now() where declared_yield_field_commodity_berries_guid = #{dto.declaredYieldFieldCommodityBerriesGuid, javaType=java.lang.String , jdbcType=VARCHAR, mode=IN}
mapper.delete: delete from declared_yield_field_commodity_berries dyfcb where dyfcb.field_id = #{fieldId}

delete from declared_yield_field_commodity_berries t where t.declared_yield_field_commodity_berries_guid in (select dyfcb.declared_yield_field_commodity_berries_guid from declared_yield_contract dyc join grower_contract_year gcy on gcy.contract_id = dyc.contract_id and gcy.crop_year = dyc.crop_year join contracted_field_detail cfd on cfd.grower_contract_year_id = gcy.grower_contract_year_id join annual_field_detail afd on afd.annual_field_detail_id = cfd.annual_field_detail_id join declared_yield_field_commodity_berries dyfcb on dyfcb.field_id = afd.field_id and dyfcb.crop_year = afd.crop_year where dyc.declared_yield_contract_guid = #{declaredYieldContractGuid} )
mapper.select: , cc.commodity_name as crop_commodity_name from declared_yield_field_commodity_berries t join crop_commodity cc on cc.crop_commodity_id = t.crop_commodity_id where t.field_id = #{fieldId} and t.crop_year = #{cropYear} order by cc.commodity_name
